options.name: parallel
options.description: A toggle that controls if the fact modules are executed in parallel or serially and in order. This can guarantee the merge order of module facts at the expense of performance. By default it will be true if more than one fact module is used. For low cost/delay fact modules parallelism overhead might end up meaning the whole process takes longer.
